item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Beach Background for My Portrait

turns.text: Swap the park behind me for a sunny beach with sand and blue sea. Keep my face, hair, sweater and head-and-shoulders framing the same. Still square, please.

item.tests: Tests beach background replacement while preserving portrait identity, framing and fine hair edges.

answer_sheet.Beach setting: A photorealistic sunny beach with visible sand and blue sea; the location is your call.
answer_sheet.What to preserve: My face, curly hair, sweater, pose and head-and-shoulders framing.
answer_sheet.Size and added text: One square image at the standard free size. No added text.

must_haves: The woman remains recognizably the same person, with the same expression and pose.
Her curly hair and sweater are preserved with clean, natural-looking edges.
Sand and blue sea replace the park background.
The portrait remains head-and-shoulders rather than inventing a full body.
The square image looks like a coherent photograph, not a visibly pasted cutout.

turns.text: Swap the park behind me for a sunny beach with sand and blue sea. Keep my face, hair, sweater and head-and-shoulders framing the same. Still square, please.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the beach version. Magic Hour turned down the edit because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created and I have no download link for you.

I tried the cheapest edit your free plan allows, which costs about 5 credits per image. The settings were:
- **Model:** flux-2-klein, at 640px (the free-plan size)
- **Shape:** square (1:1)
- **Instructions:** replace only the park with a sunny beach, golden sand and blue sea, and keep your face, curly hair, grey sweater and head-and-shoulders framing exactly the same

I didn't try a different method. The other way to swap a background also costs credits, so it would be turned down too.

**To go ahead:** add credits or buy a credit pack in your Magic Hour account, then tell me and I'll run the same edit.
